name: IQ Trophy Obby
desc:
Welcome to [IQ Trophy Obby]

[Pro Tip]: Use the Checkpoint UI on the left to save/load your position anytime.

In the latest update, badge awarding has been removed, though some badges (such as the Welcome Badge and Day Streak Badges) can still be earned.
With the new system, trophies are granted instantly without relying on badges.

❓ [How To Play]:
・ Complete unique obby stages and collect over 100 Trophies.
・ Flex your trophies on Others.
・ Spend time with Friends.
・ Test your obby Skills.

🙂 [Challenging]:
・ This game is quite challenging, so take your time and enjoy it!

[💾] If you've earned a badge, your trophies will not be lost.
・ Credits: NcraftpALT (Game Idea)

Have Fun!
